source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; Schedule of Adjustments line 17 (PDF p.20); Department FAQ 3 and 4; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40; Schedule of Credits line 2 (PDF p.28; Table 2 PDF p.44; bundle PDF p.7); Department FAQ 2

worked: Federal AGI = Railroad Retirement benefits person 0 30,000.00 + IRA distribution person 0 50,000.00 = 80,000.00. Federal taxable income = 80,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 64,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 80,000.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: line 17 railroad benefits 30,000.00; line 47 total 30,000.00; line 2b 30,000.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 80,000.00 + 0.00 - 30,000.00 = 50,000.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 50,000.00, in the band 40,001 to 80,000: 2,150.00 each; 1 exemption x 2,150.00 = 2,150.00. Line 5 = 50,000.00 - 2,150.00 = 47,850.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 47,850.00. Line 8a tax: 47,850.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (47,850.00 - 26,050.00 = 21,800.00) = 342.00 + 599.50 = 941.50. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 941.50. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 50,000.00 - 2,150.00 = 47,850.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: covered retirement income 50,000.00; 200.00 (Table 2 at 8,001 or more: 200). Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 200.00 + 0.00 = 200.00. Line 11 = 941.50 - 200.00 = 741.50. State income tax 741.50. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 942; expected keeps the formula result. The IRA distribution is covered by the credit; the railroad benefit is not. MAGI is after the line 17 deduction.
